proposals.evidence: DEDR2164 explicitly gives Parji kork- gnaw/nibble and Gondi kork-/kōrkānā bite/nibble. Survey kork/koruku/korkodu retains that same-language stem with ordinary inflection and epenthetic vowels; no Telugu borrowing is inferred from resemblance alone. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5320 gives Parji vett-/veṭṭ- wither and separate transitive vetip-. Survey vetrano/vetararo/vetata dry retains the intransitive dry family with source rhotic/stop and ordinary adjectival endings; no transitive donor is substituted. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
